args.title: Handle overlapping days in dedupe.ts for consecutive uploads
args.body:
File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

The current duplicate detection logic doesn't handle overlapping days when two statements are uploaded one after the other. Introducing a more robust mechanism to handle overlaps by integrating time-based batching or sequential processing steps could mitigate this issue.

The deduplication function does not properly handle overlapping days when two statements are uploaded consecutively. The issue requires adjusting the logic to ensure proper detection and handling of such overlaps in uploads.
